pattern: Are you still using + 物品?
note: 共享器械时先确认占用状态，短句比解释背景更自然。
ielts: 适合任何共享设施的占用确认。

slots.x: this bench
this rack
these dumbbells
this cable station
this machine
this mat
this platform
this attachment

scenario: 健身房 · 轮流与组数
pattern: take turns / work in / sets left
note: 健身房共用设备时，清楚说明轮流方式和剩余组数能显著降低摩擦。
ielts: 这些表达可迁移到其他轮流使用资源的场景。
mistake: work in 在健身房里是“穿插训练”，不是工作。

slots.x: Can we take turns?
slots.alt: Can we alternate?

slots.x: Do you mind if I work in?
slots.alt: Could we alternate sets?

slots.x: I've got two sets left.
slots.alt: Two more sets.

slots.x: I've only got one more set.
slots.alt: Just one more.

slots.x: I should be done in about five minutes.
slots.alt: I'll be finished in around five minutes.

slots.x: You can work in between my sets.
slots.z: 你可以在我组间穿插使用。
slots.alt: Feel free to work in.

slots.x: Let's alternate so neither of us has to wait.
slots.z: 我们轮流吧，这样谁都不用一直等。
slots.alt: We can alternate and keep moving.

slots.x: I'll let you know when I'm finished.
slots.alt: I'll tell you when it's free.

pattern: Could you help me + 动词?
note: 请求训练辅助时把具体动作说清楚，比只说 help 更安全。
ielts: 可训练精确请求和动作动词。
mistake: help me 后接动词原形。

slots.x: unrack this
slots.alt: Could you help me get this off the rack?

slots.x: adjust the seat
slots.alt: Can you show me how to move the seat?

slots.x: move this bench
slots.alt: Could you give me a hand moving this bench?

slots.x: load this plate
slots.alt: Can you help me put this plate on?

slots.x: take this plate off
slots.alt: Could you help me unload this side?

slots.x: check my setup
slots.alt: Could you take a quick look at my setup?

slots.x: spot this set
slots.alt: Could you give me a spot for this set?

slots.x: find the right attachment
slots.alt: Do you know which attachment I need?

scenario: 健身房 · 技术与发力
pattern: Should I / Am I / I can feel...
note: 讨论动作时聚焦一个技术变量：幅度、关节位置、发力或速度，比问“对不对”更有效。
ielts: 可用于训练中的具体反馈，也训练身体部位词汇。
mistake: feel it in + 部位；不要用 on。

slots.x: Should I keep my elbows closer in?
slots.z: 我的手肘应该再夹一点吗？
slots.alt: Should my elbows stay closer to my body?

slots.x: Am I going too deep on this?
slots.alt: Is this range too deep?

slots.x: I can feel it more in my shoulders than my chest.
slots.z: 我肩膀的感觉比胸更明显。
slots.alt: My shoulders are taking over.

slots.x: Should I slow down the lowering phase?
slots.z: 下放阶段要再慢一点吗？
slots.alt: Should I control the eccentric more?

slots.x: Does my back look too rounded here?
slots.z: 我这里背部看起来太圆了吗？
slots.alt: Am I rounding my back too much?

slots.x: Should my knees track over my toes?
slots.z: 我的膝盖应该顺着脚尖方向吗？
slots.alt: Is my knee path okay?

slots.x: I lose tension near the bottom.
slots.z: 我在底部附近会失去张力。
slots.alt: I lose tightness at the bottom.

slots.x: The last few reps get messy.
slots.z: 最后几次动作会开始乱。
slots.alt: My form breaks down on the last reps.

scenario: 健身房 · 休息与身体感受
pattern: I need / I'm feeling / I'm going to...
note: 描述恢复和不适时，应表达感受与训练选择，不把日常口语包装成医学诊断。
ielts: 可训练自我状态描述与合理暂停表达。
mistake: feel off = 状态不对；不是诊断词。

slots.x: I need another minute.
slots.alt: Give me another minute.

slots.x: I'm still catching my breath.
slots.alt: I need a moment to catch my breath.

slots.x: My knee feels a bit off today.
slots.z: 我今天膝盖感觉有点不对劲。
slots.alt: My knee doesn't feel quite right.

slots.x: I'm going to lower the weight and see how it feels.
slots.z: 我准备减轻重量看看感觉。
slots.alt: I'll drop the load and reassess.

slots.x: I'm stopping this set because the movement doesn't feel right.
slots.z: 我会停下这一组，因为动作感觉不对。
slots.alt: I'm calling the set here.

slots.x: My grip is giving out before my back.
slots.z: 我的握力比背部先撑不住。
slots.alt: My grip is failing first.

slots.x: I need a little more recovery before the next set.
slots.z: 下一组前我还需要多恢复一下。
slots.alt: I need a bit longer before I go again.

slots.x: My heart rate's still pretty high, so I'm going to wait.
slots.z: 我心率还挺高，所以我再等一会。
slots.alt: I'm going to give it another minute.

scenario: 健身房 · 礼仪与训练目标
pattern: Would you mind / I'm working on / I'm training for...
note: 健身房社交应短、具体、尊重空间；谈目标时用 working on / training for 很自然。
ielts: 这些表达适合真实健身房 small talk。
mistake: 不要把训练目标说成夸张口号；用当前重点更自然。

slots.x: Would you mind moving your bag for a second?
slots.alt: Could you move your bag for a moment?

slots.x: Could we keep this area a little clearer?
slots.z: 这里能不能尽量留空一点？
slots.alt: Would you mind leaving a bit more space?

slots.x: I'm working on my pull-ups at the moment.
slots.alt: I'm trying to improve my pull-ups.

slots.x: I'm mainly training for strength right now.
slots.alt: Strength is my main focus at the moment.

slots.x: I'm trying to get stronger without sacrificing form.
slots.z: 我想变强，但不想牺牲动作质量。
slots.alt: I want strength gains without letting my technique fall apart.

slots.x: Do I need to book this class in advance?
slots.z: 这个课需要提前预约吗？
slots.alt: Should I reserve a spot beforehand?

slots.x: Is this area reserved for personal training?
slots.z: 这个区域是私教专用的吗？
slots.alt: Is this section for PT sessions only?

slots.x: Are these plates in pounds or kilos?
slots.z: 这些杠铃片是磅还是公斤？
slots.alt: Are these marked in pounds or kilograms?
